description: This file defines the Vacancy entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It models a job vacancy with properties such as job title, hiring manager, description, number of positions, status, and timestamps, and includes ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: Vacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a job vacancy with ORM mappings, properties, and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the vacancy.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the vacancy.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the JobTitle associated with the vacancy.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle for the vacancy.

methods.name: getHiringManager
methods.description: Returns the hiring manager (Employee) for the vacancy.

methods.name: setHiringManager
methods.description: Sets the hiring manager for the vacancy.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the vacancy.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the vacancy.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the vacancy.

methods.name: getNumOfPositions
methods.description: Returns the number of positions available.

methods.name: setNumOfPositions
methods.description: Sets the number of positions for the vacancy.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status (active/inactive) of the vacancy.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the vacancy.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if the vacancy is published in the feed.

methods.name: setIsPublished
methods.description: Sets the published status of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDefinedTime
methods.description: Returns the datetime when the vacancy was defined.

methods.name: setDefinedTime
methods.description: Sets the defined time for the vacancy.

methods.name: getUpdatedTime
methods.description: Returns the last updated time of the vacancy.

methods.name: setUpdatedTime
methods.description: Sets the last updated time of the vacancy.
